description: Context-window checkpoint hook — measures the context of whoever the event is talking to (the agent's own transcript whenever the payload carries an agent_id, else the main session's) and announces once per measurement identity, per channel, when token usage crosses one of the four named checkpoints — ADVISORY, WRAP-UP, STOP, STOP-COMPROMISED — whose token figures are the transcript's model family's row of hooks/context-checkpoints.txt, the one source of the figures (Haiku takes the sonnet row, Mythos the fable row, an unknown or absent model the opus row), the family read from message.model of the entry that supplies the usage. Each warning names the checkpoint crossed and reports its implication for reasoning quality; WRAP-UP and above add the baseline instruction — main scope: wrap up and use /handover; agent scope: finish the step, record your state, and end your turn per your pause protocol — escalating to stop-immediately at STOP and STOP-COMPROMISED, the latter noting that work quality may have been compromised. Informational events (UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure — the two tool events share one announcement) inject additionalContext mid-turn; turn-end events (Stop/SubagentStop) deliver actionable (WRAP-UP and above) crossings as decision:block, forcing one delivery turn (E2E F20/F22), but skip the block when an informational channel already announced that checkpoint, or a severer one, for the same identity. SubagentStop additionally runs the sdd-controller status-line guard, matched on ^claude-toolkit:sdd-controller$ (sdd-controller-status.py): a controller reply that is not WAITING / PAUSED / STOPPED / COMPLETE is blocked once so /implement-from-plan always branches on a status line (WAITING ends a dispatch turn; the driver branches on the other three). Also ships the raw-fetch pipeline hooks: PreToolUse/WebFetch — unconditional deny that teaches the pipeline (deny-webfetch.mjs); SessionStart — injects the web-research doctrine rendered from web-doctrine.md with resolved plugin paths (inject-web-doctrine.mjs).
